description: Use to compare many input sets for the same workbook and outputs in one call. Returns indexed rows with values or errors, warnings and elapsed milliseconds. Dates are serial numbers in the workbook's date system. Each scenario starts from the original workbook and all its outputs share one recalculation. Runs stop at 10,000 scenarios, 100,000 output values, 20000 bytes including both response copies, cancellation or the time budget (55 seconds, with a 60-second hard deadline), reporting completed count and truncation. An engine crash during a scenario adds an error row counted in completed and stops the run; a crash before scenarios start returns an error. Resume by sending scenarios.slice(completed); check truncationReason before retrying and reduce outputs for output limits.

outputs.description: Sheet!A1, Sheet!A1:B5 or defined names; at most 10,000 output cells total.

path.description: Local workbook path (absolute recommended), at most 50 MiB; .xlsx, .xlsm, .xltx or .xltm.

inputs.description: Single constant or blank cells Sheet!A1, or defined names referring to one cell, mapped to numbers, strings or booleans.

name: run_scenarios
